entities.summary: Matthew Kwasi Gyamfi is a Ghanaian Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Sunyani since 2003. He is the current president of the Ghana Catholic Bishops Conference. He is also the episcopal chairman of the Catholic University of Ghana, Fiapre, and serves as a member of its governing council.
